brief:
Hamas called for mobilisation after hundreds of Israeli settlers entered the Ibrahimi Mosque in Hebron, accompanied by rabbis and National Security officials, Middle East Eye reported. A Hamas official denounced the incursion into the mosque, located in the occupied West Bank.

The entry marked a flashpoint in ongoing tensions over access to the contested holy site, which sits in the heart of Hebron's Palestinian population.
